mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, we have clear skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 69 degrees and a waning crescent moon overhead. The overnight low will be 54 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our local infrastructure, and they invite everyone to stay informed by subscribing to the official city newsletter. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several development projects, including site plans for the Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in Verona. We have Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee happening today. Tomorrow, events include the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.

In a report covering September 28 through October 5, officers responded to several incidents, including an arrest on October 3. A 19-year-old man was taken into custody after a stolen firearm was recovered from his vehicle during a traffic stop.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, before the store closes at 10:00 PM.
